飞书官方 Lark CLI + 平台 Skill。安装后在本机执行：lark-cli config init --new；lark-cli auth login --recommend；lark-cli auth status。文档：https://open.feishu.cn/document/no_class/mcp-archive/feishu-cli-installation-guide.md

Community read-only MySQL MCP server (dpflucas/mysql-mcp-server), not an Oracle/MySQL official MCP. Requires project MCP configuration with MYSQL_HOST, MYSQL_PORT, MYSQL_USER, MYSQL_PASSWORD, and optional MYSQL_DATABASE. Use a least-privilege read-only MySQL account. Prefer mysql-cli for authoritative MySQL operations.

Authoritative MySQL CLI option based on Oracle/MySQL official clients: mysql command-line client and mysqlsh MySQL Shell. No automatic install command is registered because installation differs by OS/package manager. Agents should detect mysql/mysqlsh first, then ask before installing system packages.
